trials.claim: AI browser copilot using latest AI models and custom prompt workflows to boost productivity
trials.claimQuote: ChatPlayground AI is an AI browser copilot that leverages the latest AI models and custom prompt engineering workflows to boost productivity.
trials.reasoning: A buyer says the 'latest model' label actually delivers Claude Haiku 3.5, a lower-tier model, which materially limits the latest-models promise despite praise for Copilot and productivity.

exhibits.quote: Now, hidden under the "latest model" label, you get Claude Haiku 3.5.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows the latest-model label masks delivery of an obsolete low-tier model.

exhibits.quote: They don’t even offer the services they once offered to get me to purchase this tier
exhibits.argument: The quote shows promised copilot tools were removed after purchase.

exhibits.quote: Plus, the Copilot feature is a game-changer—it gives you real-time help right on any webpage!
exhibits.argument: Vendor testimonial confirms the browser Copilot provides real-time help on any webpage.

exhibits.quote: The ChatPlayground AI app has saved me time and increased my productivity.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the app saves time and increases productivity as claimed.

trials.claim: Get outputs from different AI models at the same time
trials.claimQuote: With ChatPlayground AI, you’ll get outputs from different AI models at the same time to immediately get the information you need.
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms using 4 to 6 AI models in one window, and the vendor describes sending one input to selected models in parallel. The complaints about lost access or combined answers do not directly show simultaneous outputs fail.

exhibits.argument: The quote shows users lost access entirely so simultaneous outputs were unavailable.

exhibits.quote: Mixture AI is only giving me 1 or 2 responses and no combined answers but is still taking multiple credits.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows the product failed to return multiple simultaneous model outputs.

exhibits.quote: One input goes to the selected models in parallel, so comparison becomes a normal step instead of extra work.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states one input is sent to selected models in parallel for simultaneous outputs.

exhibits.quote: This is great for using 4 to 6 AI Models in one window.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms using 4 to 6 AI models together in one window works.

trials.claim: Enter one prompt and compare all AI results in a single window
trials.claimQuote: Enter a prompt once and compare all your AI results in a single window
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports Claude blocks when used together with models like GPT, which directly conflicts with entering one prompt and comparing all results together in a single window.

exhibits.quote: then then models like Claude block when using them together with e.g. GPT.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows models cannot be used together in one window as claimed.

exhibits.quote: You can only work on one question at a time.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows the product restricts users to a single question rather than easy comparison.

exhibits.quote: one prompt opens multiple model answers in separate columns.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states one prompt opens multiple model answers for comparison.

exhibits.quote: Compare ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more without switching tabs or rewriting the same prompt again.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms entering a prompt once to compare results without rewriting or switching tabs.
